info.name: BAFO Public API v1
info.description:
Requests of the BAFO public API (ERP integrations). Set `client_id` and `client_secret` (dashboard → Integrations → API clients), run **Get an access token**, then call any request: the token is stored in `access_token`. To use an API key instead, set the collection auth token to `{{api_key}}`.

The OpenAPI 3.1 document is at `{{base_url}}/openapi.yaml`; the reference is at `/docs/api`. No real credentials are stored in this file.

item.name: Get an access token (OAuth2 client credentials)

request.description:
Get an access token (OAuth2 client credentials)

RFC 6749 client-credentials grant. Send the client credentials with HTTP Basic (`client_id:client_secret`) or in the body. `scope` (space-separated) must be a subset of the client's scopes; all of them when omitted. Tokens last 30 minutes. This is the only response without the `{data}` envelope. Limited to 20 requests per minute per IP and client_id.
Check a credential
Describe the calling client
